clue.text: Second to be taken in by fortune-teller was David

indicators.note: the second is placed so that the fortune-teller's word swallows it

parts.note: a palmist tells fortunes by reading hands

explanation.surface: A clairvoyant gets hold of a stranger who turns out to be called David.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was' is a link word joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: King David is traditionally credited with writing the Book of Psalms, so he is the archetypal psalm writer.

clue.text: Small flighty creature, one making notes

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a songbird and a person who sings.

clue.text: One at the docks who has lost weight?

definitions.meaning: a worker who operates a flat-bottomed barge in a harbour
read whimsically as a man now less heavy

explanation.definitionFit: A lighterman works a lighter (a barge) at docks, and the word also splits as a less heavy man.

clue.text: Retains composure although upset

indicators.note: read as com-posure, the letters are composed afresh into new order

explanation.surface: Someone keeps calm despite being distressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composure' is the anagram signal (letters composed again); 'although' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in tears means crying, upset.

clue.text: Note constabulary going inside during ceasefire

indicators.note: the police word is placed within the note

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
RUC was the Royal Ulster Constabulary of Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: Police move into an area during a pause in fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: A truce is an agreement to stop fighting, a ceasefire.

clue.text: Clare arranged to include Violet on keyboard

indicators.note: the rearranged name takes the short name inside it
arranged means the letters of Clare are reordered

parts.note: Vi is the usual short form of the name Violet

explanation.surface: Clare plans to get Violet to play the piano.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' is the anagram signal and 'to include' the container signal; 'on' is a link word, so the keyboard sits at the clue's end.
explanation.definitionFit: A clavier is any keyboard instrument, such as a harpsichord or clavichord.

clue.text: Not in any manner at present is taking Ecstasy

parts.note: now means at present
E is slang for the drug Ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone currently on drugs is told it is out of the question.
explanation.definitionFit: Nowise is an old adverb meaning in no way, not at all.

clue.text: Volume that could be both ancient and modern!

definitions.text: Volume that could be both ancient and modern!

parts.words: Volume that could be both ancient and modern!
parts.note: a book, read through the title of a famous Anglican collection called Ancient and Modern

explanation.definitionFit: Hymns Ancient and Modern is a well-known Church of England song book.

clue.text: Sweet podgy person

definitions.meaning: a rolled steamed pudding, a British dessert
a plump, round person is called by the same name

explanation.definitionFit: The term names both a rolled suet pudding (a sweet, British for dessert) and a chubby person.

clue.text: Man on board called 'sir'

definitions.meaning: a chess piece shaped like a horse
one dubbed by the monarch and addressed with that title

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a chess piece and a man holding a British honour that carries the title Sir.

clue.text: Virginia in old action organised on site

indicators.note: Virginia's abbreviation sits inside the rest of the wordplay

parts.note: ex- means former, old

indicators.note: organised means the letters of action are put into new order

parts.note: VA is the US postal abbreviation for Virginia

explanation.surface: Someone from Virginia joins a former campaign put together on location.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' signals the anagram and 'in' the insertion, which lands inside the rearranged word rather than the old prefix; 'on' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: An excavation is an archaeological dig, a type of site where digging takes place.

clue.text: One article on painting in real character

parts.note: a means one
the is the definite article
painting is a form of art

explanation.surface: A single essay about a painting reveals its true nature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word placing the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'at heart' means fundamentally, in one's true nature.

clue.text: Consider this tank!

definitions.meaning: the word that precedes tank in a phrase for a research institute

explanation.definitionFit: To think is to consider, and a think tank is a body of experts.

clue.text: He will welcome call to attract attention or to exertion at sea

parts.note: taken as written
ave is the Latin greeting, hail
ho is a shout used to attract notice

explanation.surface: A man greets someone with a shout, either to get noticed or to rally sailors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will' and 'or' are link words; the word 'call' also governs the definition, which reads 'call to exertion at sea'. The blog notes the clue was amended from one for HEAVE TO.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors chanted this cry while hauling ropes together, urging effort on board ship.

clue.text: Man having many a slave

parts.note: he is a male pronoun, standing for a man
a lot means many

explanation.surface: A man owning numerous slaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A helot was a serf in ancient Sparta, hence any slave.

clue.text: Part of speech from quirky urban novel

indicators.note: quirky means odd, so the letters are rearranged oddly

explanation.surface: A grammatical feature found in an eccentric city novel.
explanation.definitionFit: A verbal noun, such as a gerund, is a noun formed from a verb, a grammatical part of speech.

clue.text: Completely cut, so to speak

indicators.note: the phrase signals that the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: to shear is to cut, as with wool

explanation.surface: A sharp remark that the hair was entirely cut off.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheer as an adverb means utterly or perpendicularly, completely.

clue.text: Not a mirage perhaps but ingrained dirt

indicators.note: perhaps suggests mirage could be rearranged into another word

parts.note: fodder taken as written
the letter dropped from the fodder

explanation.surface: What looks like an illusion is really deep-set dirt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not a' says to lose an A from MIRAGE, leaving MIRGE, which 'perhaps' rearranges. 'but' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Grime is dirt worked deep into a surface, a direct synonym for ingrained dirt.

clue.text: Enjoyment lasting a fair while

definitions.meaning: a ... also means a fairly long period

explanation.definitionFit: A good time means fun and also a considerable length of time.

clue.text: Crew recklessly capture ship that has been destroyed

indicators.note: the clue words hold the answer within them, as if captured

explanation.surface: Careless sailors seize a vessel that has been ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: A wreck is a vessel destroyed at sea, so ship that has been destroyed describes it.

clue.text: Select circular hideaway on battlefield

parts.note: to cull is to select, pick out
O is a circular letter
a den is a hideaway

explanation.surface: Choosing a round retreat on a war site.
explanation.walkthrough: CULLODEN is the 1746 Scottish battle where the Jacobites were defeated. 'on' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Culloden Moor near Inverness is the site of the last pitched battle on British soil.

annotationWithheld.clue: Old Bob with no work will

clue.text: Fictional school subject?

parts.note: a subject on the timetable that pairs with fiction as a literary genre

explanation.definitionFit: Science is a school subject, and science fiction a genre of fiction.

clue.text: Expert split first appearance proportionately

parts.note: a pro is an expert
to split is slang for to inform, to rat

indicators.note: first means take the opening letter of appearance

explanation.surface: A specialist splits on a debut showing.
explanation.definitionFit: Pro rata is Latin for in proportion, proportionately.

clue.text: Devil getting on with prison

parts.note: someone getting on in years is old
nick is British slang for prison

explanation.surface: Satan, growing elderly, finds himself in jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link word joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Old Nick is a traditional English nickname for the Devil.

clue.text: Two singers in Italy touted freely

indicators.note: freely means the letters move unconstrained into a new order

explanation.surface: A singing pair in Italy was hyped up without restraint.
explanation.definitionFit: Duetto is Italian for duet, a piece or pair of two singers.

clue.text: Molasses plant a class included

indicators.note: the plant word takes the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a tree is a plant
CL is an abbreviation for class

explanation.surface: A syrup made from a plant includes a course of lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacle is the British word for molasses, the dark syrup from sugar refining.

clue.text: Sound of bagpipes coming from runner on both sides

parts.note: a ski is a runner on snow
R and L stand for right and left
L is left, the second side

explanation.surface: A piper's noise emerging from an athlete on either flank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming from' and 'on' are link words; SKI comes first and R and L follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Skirl is the shrill wailing sound bagpipes make.

clue.text: Draw destructive one used to choose winner

parts.note: a tie is a drawn game
a breaker is one who smashes things

explanation.surface: A drawn match with a vandal brought in to settle the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiebreaker is an extra question or game played to decide a winner after a draw.

clue.text: Quarrelling with sad Dot rambling

indicators.note: rambling means the letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is arguing with a gloomy, wandering woman called Dot.
explanation.definitionFit: Being at odds means being in disagreement or conflict, quarrelling.

clue.text: Test alternative vehicle, more formal one

parts.note: the MOT is the annual British roadworthiness test for cars
or introduces an alternative
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Try a different car, a smarter one.
explanation.definitionFit: Motorcar is the fuller, more formal word for a car, the 'one' referring back to vehicle.

clue.text: Lecturer making money having knowledge

parts.note: earning means making money

explanation.surface: A lecturer gets paid for what she knows.
explanation.definitionFit: Learning is scholarship, accumulated knowledge from study.
